question: Which flying unit from 1 tier building in BAR can shoot and stun enemy targets?

4.text: PUBLIC RESPONSE: I believe the answer is the Banshee. It's a T1 flying unit built from the air plant that has both direct-fire capability and an EMP/stun effect on its primary weapon, allowing it to disable ground targets while staying mobile. This fits the "shoot and stun" criteria better than pure fighters or scouts from the same tier.

1.text:
PUBLIC RESPONSE: In the classic RTS pool the only Tier-1 Aviary / Stable output that is flying, ranged and crowd-control is the Tier-1 Aviary flying archer.

In WC3 / AoM parlance that is the Gryphon / Pegasus / Wind Rider line,
Human / Night Elf Gryphon Rider – Orc Wind Rider – AoM Pegasus Rider.
It is trained from the Tier-1 Aviary / Stable, it is a flying ranged unit and its
basic attack / rider upgrade is the stun / slowing shot that is used for
harass and micro. 

That is the unit which is normally referred to as the Wyvern / Harpy / Stun
Drake in BAR lists, i.e. the Tier-1 Aviary flying shooter with the stun
ranged attack. In AoM it is the Pegasus Rider from the Tier-1 Stable and in WC3
it is the Gryphon Rider from the Tier-1 Gryphon Aviary, the Orc equivalent
being the Wind Rider.

5.text:
In BfA the tier-1 flying shooter/stunner line is the classic Stable/Aviary
rider line.

For the vanilla BfA tech the Human mirror is the Gryphon Rider that you
get out of the Human Stable and the Night Elf/Orc mirrors are the
Hippogryph Rider / Wind Rider that you get out of the tier-1 Aviary /
Wind Rider Lair. 

It is a flying ranged unit and its basic attack is the interrupt/stun
Dive / Swoop that is used as a ranged stun/shoot in the custom map. That
is the tier-1 produced flying shooter with the stun that is normally
referred to as the Human Gryphon Rider, Orc Wind Rider / NE Hippogryph
Rider depending on the faction you are playing.

3.text:
PUBLIC RESPONSE: In the Warcraft III custom that everybody calls BAR – Base Assault Rush – the
tech tree is flattened wrt retail WC3. The only avi-able flyer that is
actually buildable out of a Tier-1 production building and that has a
ranged, CC attack is the Tier-1 aviary flyer.

In practice that is the NE Hippogryph Rider/Human Gryphon Rider line
that BAR puts out of the Tier-1 Aviary / Moon Glaive. The unit is a
ranged flying attacker and its basic attack is scripted in BAR as a
shoot-and-stun/pounce, i.e. the ranged swoop that is normally quoted as
the Gryphon/Hippogryph stun. That is the tier-1 flyer that can shoot
and stun in BAR. The UD Gargoyle is the other Tier-1 flyer that is
often cited for the same slot in BAR discussions, and in most BAR
versions the Gargoyle is the canonical Tier-1 Undead flyer with a
ranged attack.

2.text:
PUBLIC RESPONSE: In the meta that is normally talked about under that name the
Tier-1 / “first building” flyer that is used as the shoot-and-stun
interceptor is the Tier-1 Stable / Air Factory stun cavalry.

In Age of Mythology parlance that is the Stable-built Hippogriff /
Harpy type flyer, the tier-1 flying cavalry that is trained at the
Tier-1 Stable/Air Factory and is the classic “shoot + swoop-stun” air
unit. 

In BAR / Zero-K/Beyond All Reason terms that role is the Tier-1 Air
Factory interceptor that is listed in the game as the Core Kestrel /
Arm Falcon / Raven-class stun fighter – the first tier air factory
flyer that carries the EMP / paralyser burst and is the one that is
normally quoted as the tier-1 shoot-and-stun air unit. That is the
Hippogriff/Harpy equivalent that everyone calls the Tier-1 stun
fighter in the BAR air meta.
